steps: Open the official study page at https://atcliantha.com/st_petersburg_florida/study_ref_no_C1C03177.html
Confirm you meet eligibility (healthy, 18-65, Fitzpatrick skin type I-IV)
Contact recruitment via the study page to schedule medical screening
Complete screening, the 2 screening visits, optional visit, and overnight stay as directed
